name: travelling-wave-capture
description: Arithmetic: a captured ion rides a moving well, so its transit is the distance over the WAVE's speed regardless of how fast it was injected. The wave speed is ringsPerWave x ringPitch x driveFrequency = 6 x 1 mm x 0.5 MHz = 3000 m/s over 27 mm, which is 9.0 us. Injected at half that speed. Run beside travelling-wave-ballistic, which gives 18.0 us with the wave off - the pair is what says the ion is carried rather than flying. The tolerance is RELATIVE. It read 0.5, which is fifty per cent - loose enough to be nearly no assertion, though it did still exclude the 18 us ballistic answer this example is paired against. Ten per cent is a real bound: the measured transit spans 8.754 to 8.875 us across injection speeds from 0.6 to 1.4 of the wave speed.
